correctness.rationale: The Pollak circular lift is exactly measure preserving for the two statistics; the three combinatorial transition cases partition all possible favorite spots. Product-Bernoulli association and conditional richness monotonicity, strict at the last arrival, prove positive covariance for every pair of strictly increasing recodings. The Markov expectation formulas derive all local covariances and variance constants; limiting calculus yields the Lambert-W maximizing location. Standalone enumerator checked all 280392 classical parking functions through n=7 in 3048 assertions, including full bivariate distributions and conditional lucky-pattern laws. No finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Lucky arrivals concern occupied parking spots, while richness concerns occupied preferred-value categories. Their joint dependence is not fixed by the well-studied marginal laws. The result supplies a complete finite conditional mechanism, nontrivial strict increasing-transform positivity, a sharp individual arrival profile with Lambert-W peak, and a limiting correlation about 0.630879; these clarify structural coupling in a canonical random combinatorial model.
